eir.0120 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0120.t
	desc = eir.0120.desc
	theme = war
	cooldown = { years = 10 }

	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		eir_rules_occupied_land_trigger = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		random_sub_realm_county = {
			limit = { eir_county_occupied_trigger = yes }
			save_scope_as = eir_resist_county
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0120.a
		stress_impact = {
			compassionate = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		scope:eir_resist_county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_cattle_raided_modifier years = 3 } }
		add_prestige = 25
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0120.b
		trigger = {
			diplomacy >= 8
		}
		random_list = {
			55 = {
				desc = eir.out.rapp_calmed
				modifier = {
					add = 10
					diplomacy >= 10
				}
				scope:eir_resist_county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_pacified_modifier years = 6 } }
				add_prestige = 25
			}
			35 = {
				desc = eir.out.rapp_refused
				add_prestige = -25
			}
			10 = {
				desc = eir.out.rapp_betrayed
				add_prestige = -50
				scope:eir_resist_county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_native_resistance_modifier years = 4 } }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0120.c
		stress_impact = {
			greedy = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		scope:eir_resist_county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_loyal_county_modifier years = 5 } }
		remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0120.d
		add_prestige = -10
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
	}
}
